description:
The image depicts a street sign situated in front of a row of houses, with a prominent stop sign on the right side of the frame. The stop sign is red with white lettering and has a metal pole attached to it, which extends upwards and out of the frame.

To the left of the stop sign, a collection of three street signs are stacked on top of each other. The top sign reads "TO" in white letters on a blue background, while the middle sign features a blue shield
